name: docedit
description: Oakqueill PDF Editor for macOS: headless core, CLI and the Electron desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @docedit/core && npm run build -w @docedit/cli && npm run build -w @docedit/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @docedit/core && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
